text:
BUPATI LOMBOK UTARA
PROVINSI NUSA TENGGARA BARAT
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN LOMBOK UTARA
NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2017
TENTANG
PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA
BUPATI LOMBOK UTARA,
Menimbang :
a.
bahwa untuk mewujudkan hak konstitusional setiap warga Negara sesuai dengan prinsip persamaan kedudukan dihadapan hukum, maka Pemerintah Daerah perlu berupaya untuk menjamin Perlindungan hak asasi manusia bagi Perempuan dan Anak;
b.
bahwa Perempuan dan Anak termasuk kelompok rentan yang cenderung mengalami Kekerasan, sehingga perlu mendapatkan Perlindungan yang optimal;
c.
bahwa Perlindungan sebagaimana dimaksud huruf b, termasuk dalam urusan wajib yang menjadi tugas, wewenang dan tanggung jawab Pemerintah Daerah dan pencegahannya harus melibatkan semua pihak;
d.
bahwa berdasarkan pertimbangan sebagaimana dimaksud huruf a, huruf b, dan huruf c, perlu menetapkan Peraturan Daerah tentang Penyelenggaraan dan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
Mengingat :
1.
translated_text:
REGENT OF NORTH LOMBOK
PROVINCE OF WEST NUSA TENGGARA
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LOMBOK REGENCY
NUMBER 1 OF 2017
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN
BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY
REGENT OF NORTH LOMBOK,

Considering:
a.
that in order to realize the constitutional rights of every citizen in accordance with the principle of equality before the law, the Regional Government needs to make efforts to guarantee the protection of human rights for Women and Children;
b.
that Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, therefore they need to receive optimal Protection;
c.
that Protection as referred to in letter b, is included in mandatory affairs which constitute the duties, authorities and responsibilities of the Regional Government and its prevention must involve all parties;
d.
that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Implementation and Protection of Women and Children.

In View of:
1.

Part One
General

text:
Pasal 9
Setiap Perempuan dan Anak mempunyai hak dasar sebagai manusia yang wajib dilindungi, dimajukan, ditegakkan dan dipenuhi sesuai ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 9
Every Woman and Child has basic rights as a human being that must be protected, advanced, upheld and fulfilled in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 12
Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggungjawab untuk memfasilitasi upaya Perlindungan, pemajuan, penegakan dan pemenuhan hak Perempuan dan Anak sesuai kewenangannya berdasarkan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 12
The Regional Government is obligated and responsible to facilitate efforts for the Protection, advancement, enforcement and fulfillment of the rights of Women and Children in accordance with its authority based on the provisions of laws and regulations.

translated_text:
Second Part
Implementation of Protection for Women and Children

text:
Paragraf 1
Pencegahan dan Perlindungan
translated_text:
Paragraph 1
Prevention and Protection

text:
Pasal 15
(1) 	Setiap orang harus melindungi Perempuan dan Anak dari ancaman bahaya Kekerasan bagi Perempuan dan Anak.
(2) 	Setiap orang atau Lembaga dilarang melakukan pemalsuan data/ dokumen yang mengakibatkan terjadinya Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak dan/atau tidak terpenuhinya hak Anak.
translated_text:
Article 15
(1) 	Every person must protect Women and Children from the threat of danger of Violence against Women and Children.
(2) 	Every person or Institution is prohibited from falsifying data/documents that result in the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children and/or the non-fulfillment of the rights of Children.

text:

Penanganan, Pemulihan Korban Kekerasan
translated_text:
Paragraph 2

text:

text:

translated_text:
Paragraph 4
Legal Assistance

text:
Pasal 18
Pelayanan bantuan hukum ditujukan untuk memberikan Pendampingan dan Perlindungan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak korban Kekerasan dengan pendekatan responsif gender agar korban dan pelaku mendapatkan keadilan dan kepastian hak-hak hukumnya.
(2) 	Jenis pelayanan bantuan hukum meliputi:
a. 	bantuan hukum litigasi; dan
b. 	bantuan hukum non litigasi.
(3) 	Pemerintah Daerah menyelenggarakan bantuan hukum sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.
(4) 	Dalam pemberian bantuan hukum sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) Pemerintah Daerah bekerjasama dengan organisasi advocad  yang ada di Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 18
Legal aid services are intended to provide Assistance and Protection to Women and Children victims of Violence with a gender-responsive approach so that victims and perpetrators obtain justice and certainty of their legal rights.
(2) 	Types of legal aid services include:
a. 	litigation legal aid; and
b. 	non-litigation legal aid.
(3) 	The Regional Government provides legal aid in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
(4) 	In providing legal aid as referred to in paragraph (3), the Regional Government cooperates with advocate organizations in the Region.

Paragraph 6
Cultivating a Gender-Just Social System

text:
Pasal 20
(1) 	Pembudayaan sistem sosial yang berkeadilan gender meliputi :
a. 	sistem perencanaan, anggaran dan pembangunan berbasis gender;
b. 	pembangunan kapasitas SDM berbasis gender; dan
c. 	hak politik berbasis gender.
(2) 	Ketentuan yang dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksAnakan dalam bentuk pengarusutamaan gender dalam setiap kebijakan dan kehidupan Masyarakat.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) 	The cultivation of a gender-equitable social system includes:
a. 	gender-based planning, budgeting and development systems;
b. 	gender-based human resource capacity development; and
c. 	gender-based political rights.
(2) 	The provisions referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in the form of gender mainstreaming in every policy and community life.

CHAPTER VI
PARTICIPATION
Part One
Community Participation

text:
Pasal 31
(1) 	Masyarakat dapat berperan serta dalam Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
(2) 	Peran serta Masyarakat sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan dalam bentuk:
a. 	membantu Pemerintah Daerah dalam bentuk Pengawasan Perlindungan terhadap Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak;
b. 	melaporkan kepada pihak yang berwenang apabila mengetahui Perempuan dan Anak yang mengalami Kekerasan; dan
c. 	berpartisipasi dalam proses pencegahan, pemulihan, Rehabilitasi, Reintegrasi dan Pemberdayaan korban.
translated_text:
Article 31
(1) 	The Community may participate in the Protection of Women and Children.
(2) 	Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be carried out in the form of:
a. 	assisting the Regional Government in the form of Supervision of Protection over the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children;
b. 	reporting to the competent authorities if they become aware of Women and Children who experience Violence; and
c. 	participating in the process of prevention, recovery, Rehabilitation, Reintegration and Empowerment of victims.

text:
Bagian Kedua
Partisipasi Anak
translated_text:
Second Part
Child Participation

text:
Pasal 32
(1) 	Setiap Anak berhak berpartisipasi menyampaikan pendapat, ide, gagasan dan lain-lain serta terlibat dalam proses pengambilan keputusan yang berkenaan dengan hidup mereka baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung, yang dilaksAnakan dengan persetujuan dan kemauan semua Anak berdasarkan kesadaran dan pemahaman, sesuai dengan usia dan tingkat kematangan berpikir.
(2) 	Partisipasi Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dapat dilakukan melalui Forum Anak/Dewan Anak mulai dari tingkat Desa, Kecamatan, dan Kabupaten.
(3) 	Forum Anak/Dewan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) merupakan representasi Anak, baik representasi domisili geografis Anak, kelompok sosial budaya Anak, Anak berkebutuhan khusus dan latar belakang pendidikan Anak.
(4) 	Pembentukan Forum Anak/Dewan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) difasilitasi oleh Pemerintah Daerah.
(5) 	Pembentukan forum Anak/Dewan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) ditetapkan dengan Keputusan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 32
(1) 	Every Child has the right to participate in expressing opinions, ideas, thoughts and others as well as to be involved in decision-making processes concerning their lives either directly or indirectly, which is implemented with the consent and willingness of all Children based on awareness and understanding, in accordance with age and level of maturity of thinking.
(2) 	Child Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may be conducted through Children's Forums/Children's Councils starting from the Village, Sub-district, and Regency levels.
(3) 	Children's Forums/Children's Councils as referred to in paragraph (2) constitute representation of Children, whether representation of Children's geographical domicile, Children's socio-cultural groups, Children with special needs and Children's educational backgrounds.
(4) 	The establishment of Children's Forums/Children's Councils as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be facilitated by the Regional Government.
(5) 	The establishment of Children's Forums/Children's Councils as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be determined by Regent's Decree.

text:
Pasal 33
Sumber pembiayaan Forum Anak/Dewan Anak dapat berasal dari :
a. 	sumbangan dari Masyarakat/Badan Usaha yang bersifat tidak mengikat;
b. 	bantuan dari Pemerintah Daerah; dan/atau
c. 	sumber-sumber pembiayaan lainnya sesuai dengan peraturan perundangan-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 33
Sources of financing for the Children's Forum/Children's Council may come from:
a. 	contributions from the Community/Business Entities that are non-binding in nature;
b. 	assistance from the Regional Government; and/or
c. 	other sources of financing in accordance with laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 34
(1) 	Dalam setiap penyusunan kebijakan yang terkait dengan Anak, Pemerintah Daerah memperhatikan dan mengakomodasi pendapat Anak yang disampaikan melalui Forum Anak/Dewan Anak.
(2) 	Pemerintah Daerah dapat mengikutsertakan perwakilan Forum Anak/Dewan Anak dalam Musyawarah Perencanaan Pembangunan Daerah.
translated_text:
Article 34
(1) 	In every formulation of policies related to Children, the Regional Government shall consider and accommodate the opinions of Children conveyed through the Children's Forum/Children's Council.
(2) 	The Regional Government may include representatives of the Children's Forum/Children's Council in the Regional Development Planning Deliberation.

text:
BAB VII
PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN
Pasal 35
Bupati berkewajiban melakukan pembinaan dan Pengawasan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak.
Pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: menyelenggarakan bimbingan teknis dan pelatihan; dan menyediakan fasilitas untuk pemenuhan Standar Pelayanan.
Pembinaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan untuk mewujudkan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak sesuai Standar Pelayanan yang dilaksAnakan oleh P2TP2A dan Lembaga-Lembaga yang melaksAnakan layanan pemenuhan dan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 35
The Regent is obligated to conduct guidance and Supervision of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
The guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: organizing technical guidance and training; and providing facilities for the fulfillment of Service Standards.
The guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted to realize the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children in accordance with Service Standards implemented by P2TP2A and Institutions that implement services for the fulfillment and Protection of Women and Children.

text:
Pasal 36
Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada Pasal 35 ayat (1)  meliputi: melakukan pemantauan dan evaluasi terhadap Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak; dan menerima dan menindaklanjuti laporan.
Pelaksanaan Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan secara transparan dan akuntabel.
translated_text:
Article 36
Supervision as referred to in Article 35 paragraph (1) includes: conducting monitoring and evaluation of the Implementation of Protection of Women and Children; and receiving and following up on reports.
The Implementation of Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted in a transparent and accountable manner.

text:
BAB VIII
PELAPORAN
Pasal 37
(1) 	SKPD yang menyelenggarakan tugas dan fungsi bidang Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak menyampaikan laporan kepada Bupati tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Daerah.
(2) 	Laporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) disampaikan sekurang-kurangnya 1 (satu) kali dalam setahun.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
REPORTING
Article 37
(1) 	The SKPD that carries out the duties and functions in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection shall submit a report to the Regent regarding the Implementation of Women's and Child Protection in the Region.
(2) 	The report as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be submitted at least 1 (one) time per year.

text:
BAB IX
PEMBIAYAAN
Pasal 38
Pembiayaan pelaksanaan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak dibebankan pada APBD dan sumber dana lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
FINANCING
Article 38
Financing for the implementation of the Administration of Protection for Women and Children shall be charged to the APBD and other legitimate and non-binding sources of funds.

Pasal 39
Setiap orang atau Lembaga yang melanggar ketentuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat (2) diancam pidana kurungan paling lama 6 (enam) bulan dan/atau denda paling banyak Rp. 50.000.000,- ( lima puluh juta rupiah).

Article 39
Every person or Institution that violates the provisions as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) shall be punishable by imprisonment of a maximum of 6 (six) months and/or a fine of a maximum of Rp. 50,000,000,- (fifty million rupiah).
The criminal act as referred to in paragraph (1) is a violation.
Every person or legal entity that violates the provisions of Article 23 shall be punishable based on the provisions of the applicable laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 40
Bagi Pegawai Negeri Sipil yang melakukan suatu tindakan atau tidak melakukan suatu tindakan yang dapat menghalangi atau mempersulit salah satu pihak yang dilayani sehingga mengakibatkan kerugian bagi yang dilayani dalam hal pengurusan hak sipil terhadap pemenuhan hak Anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 11 huruf e dan huruf f, dikenakan hukuman disiplin sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku dan/atau sanksi administratif berupa pemberhentian sementara dari jabatan.
Mekanisme pemberian sanksi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 40
For Civil Servants who commit an act or fail to commit an act that can obstruct or complicate one of the parties being served resulting in losses for those being served in matters of civil rights administration regarding the fulfillment of Children's rights as referred to in Article 11 letter e and letter f, disciplinary punishment shall be imposed in accordance with applicable laws and regulations and/or administrative sanctions in the form of temporary dismissal from position.
The mechanism for imposing sanctions as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.

text:
PENJELASAN
ATAS
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN LOMBOK UTARA
NOMOR   TAHUN 2017
TENTANG
PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
UMUM
Negara  memiliki  kewajiban  memberikan  Perlindungan  kepada  setiap  warga negara sesuai pembukaan UUD Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945. Bahwa Perempuan dan Anak termasuk kelompok rentan yang cenderung mengalami Kekerasan sehingga perlu mendapatkan  Perlindungan.  Kekerasan terhadap  Perempuan  dan  Anak merupakan pelanggaran hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamin hak hidupnya tanpa adanya diskriminasi.
Kekerasan  merupakan setiap  perbuatan  secara  melawan  hukum  dengan  atau  tanpa menggunakan  sarana  terhadap  fisik  dan  psikis  yang  menimbulkan  bahaya bagi nyawa,   badan   atau   menimbulkan   terampasnya kemerdekaan seseorang. Selanjutnya  Kekerasan  terhadap  Perempuan  merupakan  setiap  tindakan  berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin  yang  berakibat  atau  mungkin  berakibat  kesengsaraan  atau penderitaan Perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan atau perampasan    kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah  publik  atau  dalam  kehidupan  pribadi.  Kekerasan terhadap  Anak  adalah  setiap  perbuatan  terhadap  Anak  yang  berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan  atau  penderitaan  secara  fisik,  mental,  seksual,  psikologis, termasuk penelantaran dan perlakuan buruk yang    mengancam    integritas tubuh dan merendahkan martabat Anak.
Keberadaan Perempuan  dan  Anak  Korban  Kekerasan belum  mendapatkan    Pelayanan    yang    memadai    sehingga    diperlukan    Pelayanan minimal untuk korban Kekerasan. Dalam  rangka  mencegah  dan  menanggulangi  Kekerasan  terhadap  Perempuan dan  Anak  di  Kabupaten  Lombok Utara  agar  terhindar  dari  Kekerasan,  ancaman  Kekerasan, penyiksaan  atau  perlakuan  yang  merendahkan  derajat  dan  martabat  kemanusiaan, perlu dilakukan Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  terhadap  Perempuan  dan  Anak dalam bentuk Peraturan Daerah. Peraturan Daerah ini mengatur upaya Perlindungan bagi Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan khususnya dalam hal   Pelayanan, pemantauan dan evaluasi, pelaporan, pendanaan,  pembinaan  dan  Pengawasan.
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LOMBOK REGENCY
NUMBER   YEAR 2017
CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence and therefore need to receive Protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children.

The existence of Women and Child Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate Services and therefore minimum Services for victims of Violence are required. In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in North Lombok Regency so that they are protected from Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to implement Protection for Women and Children in the form of a Regional Regulation. This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women and Child Victims of Violence particularly in terms of Services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and Supervision.
